proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10555 *rakṣāpuṭaka explicitly includes Gujarati rākhɔṛɔ/rākhɔṛī ashes. The survey rakhoḍo/rakhoḍi forms retain the extended compound ending and select 10555 rather than simple rakṣā 10552. Exact survey form rākhoḍi is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

records.Source: varkey-vunnamatla2018bareli[Appendix C.3, printed p. 98, item 57, Nimadi-Khargone]
